## 3. Notable Featured Projects

### 1. CutCount — Offline Barber Tracking & Revenue Management Application
- **Category**: Mobile Application (Business & Finance)
- **Platforms**: Android, iOS
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Isar DB, Provider, Custom Sketch Design
- **Repository**: https://github.com/fazal-e-haq/CutCount.git
- **Key Features**:
  - 100% offline-first local database using Isar DB.
  - Daily haircut counter and dynamic revenue calculation based on custom service rate cards.
  - Daily, weekly, and monthly balance summaries and tipping statistics.
  - Tactile Hand-Drawn Brutalism interface designed for single-hand barber usage.

### 2. CopyFlutter — Open-Source Flutter UI Component Library
- **Category**: Developer Tooling & Web Application
- **Platforms**: Flutter Web, Android, iOS
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter Web, Firebase, GetX, Dart, WebAssembly
- **Live URL**: https://copy-flutter.web.app
- **Key Features**:
  - Curated library of responsive, copy-paste Flutter UI components, loaders, animated buttons, and cards.
  - Live interactive widget previews running directly in the browser.
  - Instant copy-to-clipboard code snippets.
  - Zero third-party bloat dependencies.
